facts.text: Lake of the Woods sits in Mahomet Township, surrounded by oak‑hickory forests and prairie remnants within an 873‑acre forest preserve.
Its 8‑mile northwest location from Champaign places it just outside the village of Mahomet, a detail that shaped its early settlement patterns.
Native American Kickapoo originally inhabited the area until a 1819 treaty ceded the land, leading to their displacement west of the Mississippi.
Pioneer roads like the Urbana‑to‑Bloomington state road (1835) and the Danville‑to‑Fort Clark trail crossed nearby, linking farms to markets by the early 1830s.
The lake supports fishing for bass and catfish, and a boathouse on a peninsula offers seasonal rentals, making it a local recreation hub.
